blocks.text: A Dental CPA Explains Why Titling of Assets is Vital for Protecting Your Property

Titling of assets is an important aspect of protecting your property in retirement and for making sure there are no unexpected legal hurdles for your heirs after your death. A dental CPA from Reliance Consulting, LLC, can help make sure that your assets are titled correctly, in a way that is suited to your unique situation.

Titling of assets can be accomplished in several ways working with your [dental CPA](http://reliancecpa.com/dental-cpa) from Reliance. Some of the most common are listed below, but first, here is a look at the kinds of assets we’re talking about:

items.text: Real property (home or other piece of property)

blocks.text: Why is titling of assets important? Because the potential unexpected costs could include unnecessary taxes, or an increase in capital gains taxes for your heirs, especially if the value of the estate exceeds the amount that is exempt from the estate tax.
